description: This PHP source file defines the ClaimExpenseTypeAPI class within the OrangeHRM project. The class Implements REST API endpoints for managing claim expense types, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting expense types. It utilizes annotations for OpenAPI documentation and integrates with the core service layer and data models. The file is part of the Claim plugin API in the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: ClaimExpenseTypeAPI
classes.description: A REST API endpoint class for managing claim expense types in the OrangeHRM system, providing CRUD operations and utilizing OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove specified expense types by IDs.

methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve details of a single expense type by ID, including whether it can be edited.
